measuredIn: Chromium 1x, TZ=UTC, viewBox user units, .chart-label in the app's sans stack
faces: system fallback (-apple-system) as rendered while display=swap is pending
note: em = getComputedTextLength() / font-size, the largest reading over every face, size and viewport width above. A lone U+0020 measures 0 because SVG collapses a leading space; its advance is covered by the strings that contain one. The browser was pinned to UTC, the zone the suite runs in, and reported it back before measuring: the date axis writes a different string for the same instant in every zone, so a fixture measured in one is unusable in another. More strings are listed than the pinned matrix produces — earlier readings taken at UTC+10 are kept, because they are real renderings of the same instants for a reader in that zone and the estimate has to hold for them too. Where a string was measured twice, the wider reading is the one recorded.
